reviews.review: This game is nothing short of an absolute masterpiece. I first came to know half life back in 2024 when one of my friends mentioned it because we were playing Gmod and he spawned the buggy from later chapters of the game (yes ik i was playing gmod and didnt even know what half life was lol) This then caused me to look at the steam page for half life 2, think its cool, and wishlist it, never to be seen again (until it was). Then, while looking through my emails, i found one from steam stating that half life 2 was on sale. At the time I didn't have a good relationship with my friends, I was always trying to fit in and do what I thought made me look the "coolest" in their eyes. And so, in an effort to relate to them, I bought the game, played it for about 30 min, loved it, and went to go tell my friends, you wanna know what they said? "ok" and "cool" that was it. From that moment on I realized that nobody actually cares what I do, they pretend to dislike you for not doing something, and then when you do that thing they care even less. So you wanna know what I did? i played half life 2, i beat half life 2, then i played half life 1, then i played half life 2 in vr, then episode 1, then episode 1 in vr, and then episode 2 in vr, and then i spent hours and hours watching half life args, mod vids, funny clips, short films, theories, becoming so obsessed with the game i would fall asleep every night listening to city 17 ambience. I'm even in the process of building my own fully functioning bullet resistant HEV suit, and all that I can say is, half life (as a series) is the greatest piece of media to ever grace this amazing planet. Half life taught me how to keep going when it's hard, how to do hard things simply because others might benefit, and most importantly, how to love myself when no one else does. After playing half life 2 I became openly a furry, and openly Bi, and i didnt care, i didnt care who thought what anymore, sure i lost some friends, but if i lost them because i became my true self, then were they ever my friends in the first place? If you take anything from this review, (other than of course playing half life lol) it's that the only person that has an opinion that actually matters is you, pay no attention to all the people that think you can't do it, be like Gordon, and do it anyway. Thank you, Half Life and VALVe.

Half-Life 2 feels like a rampage of creativity and ambition, the kind of game that still seems to come from somewhere else, like the Voyager probes: so well made it never really stopped traveling. The blue palette, the clockwork mechanics, the sheer megalomania of its world keep pulling me back.
Valve was a myth to me as a kid. Even now, with Deadlock, Alyx shifting the lore and Episode 3 still missing, I'm waiting to see what the devs do next.
